body:
Kept going per "dont stop until complete." Found the most on-topic thing of the whole session, directly tied to what you just described about edge.

Two more small metrics-gap findings disclosed (not wired -- needed a trade-close integration point I couldn't confidently locate this pass): a prediction-accuracy self-calibration system that's never fed a single data point (fails safe, just inert), and a slingshot-recovery-mode win-rate that's always logged as 0% (cosmetic, not decision-affecting). Plus 3 low-priority confirmed-dead helpers, disclosed and held.

THE BIG ONE: I went and checked the "Living-Edge" system directly, because what you described in words -- edge as many situational for/against moments, not one universal edge, understanding market DNA and cause-and-effect chains -- is LITERALLY what this system already does. It's real, it's live, it's computing correctly right now: per-regime-cell posterior edge, variance, and a capped-Kelly size for each cell, fed by a coherence/relationship signal from forge-indicate. Confirmed via direct trace, not the tool that had the bug.

It computes all of this correctly -- and then only prints it to a diagnostic log. Never touches an actual trade. This was a DELIBERATE choice from WARRANT#72 (2026-07-19): "no live wiring before a powered run" -- i.e., not enough real per-cell trade history yet to trust a live per-cell Kelly size statistically.

This is genuinely the calibration/edge lever you're asking about. But wiring it into live sizing is a real execution change -- it would start controlling actual position size per market situation -- and the system's own "enough data yet?" precondition hasn't been re-checked against where your live sample sizes actually stand today. I'm not going to flip that on by assumption.

Do you want me to: (a) check whether the powered-run threshold is actually met yet and report back with real numbers before touching anything, or (b) go further and wire it in if the data supports it, or (c) leave it as the confirmed, ready, well-understood next lever and stop here for tonight?

Everything shipped this pass compiled 0/0, verified byte-identical across all 3 locations, ledgers current.
